text: わしの　やったポケモンは…ほう　だいぶ　なついた　みたいだな？

structure.jp: わしの　やった　ポケモンは…

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしの　やった　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A plain-form verb placed before a noun describes that noun. わしのやったポケモン = 'the Pokémon I gave'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: なついた　みたいだな
patterns.explanation: みたいだ says it seems that. な asks for agreement. なついたみたいだな = 'It seems it has taken to you, hm?'
